tool.name: alevin-fry infer
tool.command: ln -s '$input_quant_dir.extra_files_path/$input_quant_dir.metadata.store_root/quant_output' input && #if $input_quant_subset: ln -s '$input_quant_subset' quant_subset.txt && #end if mkdir output && alevin-fry infer --count-mat input/geqc_counts.mtx --eq-labels input/gene_eqclass.txt.gz --output-dir output $input_usa_mode #if $input_quant_subset: --quant-subset quant_subset.txt #end if && mkdir -p '$output_dir.extra_files_path/infer_output' && mv output/* '$output_dir.extra_files_path/infer_output'

param.name: input_quant_dir
param.label: alevin-fry quant output
param.help: Output of the alevin-fry quant tool when used with 'Write equivalence class counts'.

param.name: input_quant_subset
param.label: List of barcodes to quantify
param.help: One barcode per line in the file. Barcodes not in this list will be ignored during inference and will not appear in the output quantification matrix. If this input is left empty, then all of the original barcodes will be quantified.

param.name: input_usa_mode
param.label: USA mode
param.help: Whether the input equivalence classes were computed in USA mode.

tool.help:
This tool runs **alevin-fry infer**, performing inference on equivalence class count data. For further details, see the alevin-fry documentation: https://alevin-fry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
----
**Input**
- Output directory of **alevin-fry quant** when run with "Write equivalence class counts" enabled.
----
**Output**
- Inference results (directory)
